states.name: grind coffee beans
states.definition: Fetching, opening, and grinding coffee beans into the espresso cup including logging ingredients on phone.

states.name: tamp coffee grounds
states.definition: Distributing, pressing, and prepping the ground coffee in the portafilter or cup.

states.name: brew espresso shot
states.definition: Locking in the cup, turning on the machine, and waiting for the espresso to extract.

states.name: serve espresso shot
states.definition: Removing the finished espresso cup, retrieving a plate, and turning off the machine.
